# ZFC Partners

> Independent investment platform focused on energy infrastructure, industrial services and real
> asset development across Latin America. Two operating platforms, a development pipeline of more
> than 870 MW across wind, solar and battery storage, and four projects in active development in
> Peru. Everything below is taken from what the company publishes on its own site.

Contact and language: https://zfcpartners.com/ · Spanish version at https://zfcpartners.com/?lang=es

## The two platforms
- **ZFC Energy Group** — independent power producer developing 870+ MW across wind, solar and BESS.
  Manages the full development lifecycle from greenfield to Ready-to-Build, partnering with EPC
  contractors for construction and long-term ownership. Stated target: 2 GW+ by 2030.
- **Fitcon Energy** — industrial services and infrastructure platform enabling vertical integration
  across the portfolio: equipment supply, technical services, EPC, O&M and asset management, with
  expansion into data centre and energy infrastructure. Ten business lines, 8+ years of operation.

## Projects in active development (Peru)
- [Olmos Wind](https://zfcpartners.com/projects/olmos-wind.html) — Olmos, Lambayeque.
- [Frontera](https://zfcpartners.com/projects/frontera.html)
- [Aurelión](https://zfcpartners.com/projects/aurelion.html)

- Index of all project profiles: https://zfcpartners.com/projects/
